data.description: Step Into Luxury | Vitalia Residences on The Palm
data.long_description:
Experience Riviera‑Inspired Luxury on the Shores of Palm Jumeirah

Welcome to Vitalia, an ultra‑exclusive collection of just 45 bespoke residences by Pinnacle Developers, perched on the prestigious East Crescent of Palm Jumeirah. This boutique 10‑storey development blends the timeless elegance of the Italian Riviera with the vibrant energy of Dubai’s most iconic island.

Italian Snaidero kitchens with Miele appliances
Parquet wood flooring & Dekton countertops
Gessi fittings & Pianca wardrobes
Smart home automation throughout

Enjoy world-class amenities:

Infinity-edge pool with panoramic views
Direct private beach access
Fully equipped Technogym fitness centre
Concierge, valet, 24/7 security & EV charging

Located minutes from Atlantis, Nakheel Mall & Dubai Marina, with breathtaking sea and skyline views.
